    LIMIT 3

        p.article_id AS article_id,
        p.paragraph_index AS paragraph_index,
        p.text AS text,
        p.distance AS paragraph_distance

RelatedImages AS (
    SELECT
        i.image_id AS image_id,
        i.article_id AS article_id,
        i.filename AS filename,

        i.url AS url,
        i.distance AS image_distance
      FROM i_filtered AS i

)

FROM
  SimilarParagraphs sp
JOIN
  RelatedImages ri ON toString(sp.article_id) = toString(ri.article_id)
